firstPlayerRule: The player who most recently sold a weapon to an orc takes the first turn. If nobody has, choose the starting player randomly.
clarifications: In later seasons, the player who triggered the end of the previous season takes the first turn.
internalEvidence: The Minion Games English manual, hosted by retailer Gamer’s HQ, was rendered and visually checked. Printed page 2 gives the most-recent orc-weapon seller and an explicit random fallback. Printed page 10 assigns the first turn in a new season to the previous season-ending player. The title, Minion Games logo, and weapon-crafting game match inventory BGG 59936. SHA-256: 1232505de20dbed942f8ff9f0e41488464b2a3964053abf2b93b957348923058. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-22. Editorial review 2026-09-24: Rechecked the rendered pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
uncertainty: The manual supplies a random fallback if nobody has sold a weapon to an orc, but does not specify a tie procedure among qualifying players.
